decisions.rationale: Acute respiratory distress syndrome (ARDS) can be a complication of COVID-19 pneumonia, as indicated by the progression of COVID-19 pneumonia to ARDS in clinical conditions.
Acute hypoxemic respiratory failure can be a manifestation of COVID-19 pneumonia, as patients with COVID-19 pneumonia may present with respiratory symptoms and hypoxemia.
